The purpose of this exploratory framework is to catalog presidential election anomalies, specifically focusing on the 2020 U.S. presidential election. The analysis will utilize a hypothetical twin-variable approach to assess the intersection of transparency and opacity in voting processes across various counties, while also considering the methodologies employed by official audit vendors. The baseline confidence intervals will be established using Minnesota's voter verification procedures, which will serve as a reference point for the analysis presented to the Board of Governors.
